subject: Renewal playbook and QBR availability — next steps

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Brooks <ava.brooks@novusplatform.com>; Novus Platform Procurement <procurement@novusplatform.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal playbook and QBR availability — next steps

Hi Ava / Novus team,

Hope you’re doing well — wanted to kick off the renewal and capacity discussion so we can lock timelines and staffing for the upcoming commitment. High-level proposal below: 

- Term: 12 months (renewal window: Nov 1 start)
- Capacity: baseline commit at current level + 20% uplift (we can profile usage after the first 30 days)
- Key milestones: mutual action plan (MAP) agreed, QBR within the first 30 days of the new term, legal signature and PO in advance of Nov 1

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm primary stakeholders (we’ll invite them to the QBR)
2) Quick calendar poll for QBR dates (target window Oct 22–Nov 2)
3) We’ll share a MAP and proposed pricing sheet for the uplift and committed vs burst options

I’ve attached a draft MAP and a .ics poll for QBR slots. Could you confirm who from your side should be at the QBR (product, infra, procurement)? Also flag if you need a different term length.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with proposed pricing and a short runbook.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0138

Attachments: Novus_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.xlsx, qbr-slot-poll.ics

Date: 2029-10-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal playbook and QBR availability — next steps

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear kickoff.

Quick answers:
- Stakeholders: me (Prod), Samir (Infrastructure), and Leila Ahmed (Security — I’ll loop her after procurement).
- Term: 12 months is fine; we’re evaluating a 20% uplift as you suggested.
- Procurement: Samir will own the PO; procurement@novusplatform.com is on thread.

We’re available for a QBR on Oct 25 or Oct 30 (prefer Oct 25 AM PT). If those work, please lock and send invites.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you share committed vs burst pricing for the 20% uplift (spread out as a monthly rate)?
2) Can you include a short operations runbook in the MAP (who to call for incidents, escalation path)?

Thanks — looping Samir.

Best,
Ava Brooks
Director, Product
Novus Platform

Date: 2029-10-10T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal playbook and QBR availability — internal pricing note

Karthik / Ben — internal note before we send pricing to Novus:

- For a 12-month committed uplift of +20%, recommend the following pricing lanes to present:
  * Committed (preferred): 15% discount on hosted per-token rate with guaranteed baseline throughput and dedicated burst slots during business hours.
  * Hybrid (cost-savings): lower commitment with dynamic burst credits — good for customers with spiky inference.
  * Burst-only (no commit): higher per-token rate, no dedicated capacity SLA.

- Operationally, we should include a short runbook (1 page) that lists on-call, incident escalation (CS -> Infra -> Eng), and a contact for SLO exceptions. Monica will draft the runbook and the recommended pricing table.

I’ll attach the recommended pricing worksheet to the next mail; flagging we might need legal for a small wording change in the SLA around burst behavior.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

What’s in this MAP v3:

- Timeline to signature (target: week of Oct 21)
- Pricing lanes (Committed / Hybrid / Burst) with high-level numbers — Monica will follow up with the detailed worksheet in a separate mail

Action items for Novus:

- Confirm final stakeholder list (we’ll invite Leila for security if needed)

If Oct 25 AM works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (30m).

Thanks — attaching: Novus_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.xlsx, qbr-slot-poll.ics

Best,
